recipes.name: Watermelon Pizza
instructions: Wash the watermelon and cut into 1 inch (2 cm) thick rounds.
Top each round with a couple of scoops of yogurt, and spread it so that it almost reaches the rind.
Cut into slices and top with fruits and other desired toppings. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based yogurt that is fortified with calcium .
Storage Best if enjoyed immediately. Pre-made watermelons can be stored in airtight container s in the fridge for up to 1 day.
